Description: This is an audiobook of a 1905 speech (re-edited by Debs and published in 1909) of a speech called "Industrial Unionism" in which Debs, having recently co-founded the Industrial Workers of the World (IWW) labor union, makes the case for craft or trade unionism's being out of date and for industrial unionism, the organizational basis for the IWW, to take its place. It is a phenomenally stirring condemnation of capitalism and a good example of Marxist principles put into plain language.

The original text is here: https://archive.iww.org/PDF/history/library/Debs/Debs5.pdf
